title: Intensifying Judgements with -ísimo and Resultar
goal: Deliver vivid evaluations by pairing *resultar* with attitude adjectives and *-ísimo* superlatives

items: I can form *-ísimo* superlatives accurately, including spelling changes like *riquísimo* and *larguísimo*.
I can pair *resultar* with vivid attitude adjectives like *entrañable*, *cursi* and *despectivo*.
I can avoid double intensification like *muy riquísimo* and keep agreement accurate after *resultar*.
